details: Valid for every $n\ge1$; the value field includes the one-concept boundary.
proof: A proper projection onto $k<n$ coordinates consists of the empty trace and its $k$ singleton traces. Its one-inclusion graph is a $k$-leaf star with average degree $2k/(k+1)$. This increases with $k$ and is maximized at $k=n-1$, giving $2(n-1)/n$. The full projection has only singleton traces and is edgeless, so cannot improve the maximum. For $n=1$ both possible projections are edgeless and the same formula gives zero.
name: Projected Double Density or Projected Average Degree of Singletons
